Create realistic, production-quality UI design with clear hierarchy, strong typography and purposeful spacing. This is a REVISED Parvoz Drone Simulator Hangar drone-selection concept for adult FPV simulator players. The user rejected cartoonish plastic buttons, ornamental science-fiction consoles, chunky capsules, exaggerated italic typography and generic AI dashboards. Serious, quiet, mature simulation UI. Target dimensions 1920 x 1080 landscape, exact 16:9 composition. Current date 28 October 2026; no date text needed.

Attached image is the ACTUAL CURRENT PUBLIC GAME screenshot captured today, not an inspiration scene. It defines the exact placement of the existing drone. IMPORTANT OUTPUT CONTRACT: generate ONLY the NEW UI as a genuinely transparent RGBA overlay, NOT the hangar, drone, scenery, shadows over the scene or a checkerboard. The actual screenshot will be placed unchanged underneath your transparent output using a separate browser image layer. Leave the large central area x=380..1400, y=280..820 completely alpha-zero so the real drone stays visible. Do not draw any drone, thumbnail, object, reflection or scene elements. Never recreate or enhance the screenshot. Do not use a black or white full-canvas backing. Only actual UI panels/text/button areas are opaque. Output is a single full-frame UI overlay. Do not show phone/device/browser chrome, multi-option board, design commentary or callouts.

Design only the Hangar selection workflow, NOT Workbench or part editing. Show title 'АНГАР', current drone 'Luma 5 Copy 1', subtitle '5″ • Фристайл', concise read-only characteristic scales with exact values 'Вес 595 г', 'Отклик моторов 35 мс', 'Энергия 28.9 Вт·ч', 'Тяга / вес 5.6×', 'Полёт ≈ 6 мин'. Scales are quiet thin bars WITHOUT slider handles, not editable. One primary button 'В МАСТЕРСКУЮ', secondary text link 'Главное меню'. Six drone names in a compact selection list: 'Chameleon 5″', 'Gecko 3″', 'Dquad Addiction', 'Kestrel 5', 'Luma 5', 'Luma 5 Copy 1' (selected). Text names only, no invented pictures/icons/photos. No new logos. PARVOZ is a small simple wordmark if needed. Readable body text at 18–22 px on this 1920 canvas; headings controlled, no oversized poster type. Do not fill empty space with extra metrics, cards, badges, features or marketing text. Spacing/grouping first, simple dividers second; flat surfaces only if required, borders sparingly. No nested cards, large rounding, 3D bevels, glow, decorative crosshairs, neon, orange-blue blockbuster aesthetic, gamepad controller illustration or cartoon art. Keep the calm, realistic industrial garage visible through transparency. Respect the source image geometry and do not stretch imagery.

One restrained muted warm-amber fine highlight. Left upper x50..700 y65..210 has small wordmark, restrained title and one-line subtitle. Primary action belongs at the bottom of the right inspector. Precise tabular aligned numeric values and thin muted bar scales in that same unified inspector. Leave everything else transparent. Grounded modern racing simulator UI without copying any existing game's branding. Elegant Swiss grid and sensible 24/32 px spacing. Heading 36px maximum. No rounded pills.
